title: Everting interrupted suture
view: Two cut-away sections through skin across a laceration, skin surface up: the bite placed with the wound open (top) and the same suture tied (bottom).
teachingPoint: Enter at 90 degrees and take a bite wider at its base than at the surface, the same depth on both sides; tied, the edges rise into a slight everted ridge.
claims: Needle entry at 90 degrees to the skin about 4 mm from the edge (standard technique; record: entry angle sets eversion).
Bite flask-shaped: wider at its base than at the surface, through the dermis into the top of the fat, equal depth both sides (standard technique; record: bite depth sets eversion).
Tied: the edges meet and rise into a slight ridge (record: edge eversion).
Labels: 90° entry, Dermis, Wider at depth, Everted edges, Knot.

geometry.why: the knot sits on the surface
the tied panel is below the open one
